Open Lake Forecast for Lake America
National Weather Service Buffalo NY
402 PM EST Sun Nov 15 2026

For waters beyond five nautical miles of shore on Lake America

Waves are the significant wave height - the average of the highest
1/3 of the wave spectrum. Occasional wave height is the average of
the highest 1/10 of the wave spectrum.

.SYNOPSIS...A 30.5 inch high will gradually build from the Upper 
Midwest to the mid-Atlantic States through Wednesday...where it will 
then remain through Friday while a 29.7 inch low tracks across 
northern Ontario and Quebec Provinces.
